role.altitude: The music therapist in research keeps designing studies, recruiting and consenting clients, running sessions, analysing and interpreting; screening every abstract, copying paper outcome forms into spreadsheets and drafting method and result text from scratch shrink.
skills_to_grow: Checking drafted text against the analysis output and sources
role.ambitious_version: A clinician-researcher whose study data are clean when the last session ends.

tasks.short: Search and screen literature, write the protocol and ethics application, recruit and consent participants, run sessions and score outcomes, enter data, analyze, and write the report to conduct or assist in music therapy research.

steps.what: Music therapist searches and screens the research literature
Music therapist writes the research protocol and ethics application
Music therapist recruits participants and obtains informed consent
Music therapist conducts study sessions and scores outcome measures
Music therapist enters outcome data in the study data set
Music therapist analyzes the study data and interprets the results
Music therapist writes the research report or paper

loop.input: The protocol, the analysis output tables and the screened literature list.
loop.check: Every number must match the analysis output and every citation must resolve to a DOI in the screened list; the therapist reads each sentence against the analysis and the cited study to see it says what the source says, with its limits, and rewrites the discussion.
loop.stop: The therapist keeps a section, or writes it by hand after two redrafts.
loop.why_not_simpler: Methods and results text must follow this study's design and output.

tasks.design: A screening tool ranks search results by likely relevance as the therapist marks abstracts, so fewer records are read before the relevant ones are found; the therapist still decides every inclusion. Outcome forms are electronic study forms with range checks, filled during or right after the session, instead of paper forms copied into a spreadsheet. Designing, consenting, scoring and interpreting stay with the therapist. Methods and results drafts come from the analysis tables, every number matching the output and every citation resolving to a screened source. Study data are pseudonymised and kept apart from the clinical record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Abstracts were screened one by one and paper forms retyped.
tasks.enabler_now: Screening tools that rank records, electronic study forms and drafting checked against output tables.
tasks.still_hard: Small studies where every participant matters for the result.
tasks.human_edge: Choosing outcome measures that capture what music changes.
tasks.altitude: Less screening and retyping; research judgement stays.

reach.learn: Whether data are ready for analysis sooner.

evidence.claim: Screening tools rank literature records by likely relevance as a reviewer marks them.
Providers are legally responsible for careful use of generative AI.

assumptions: Boundary: conducting research; applying findings to practice (task 19189) and analysing effectiveness in practice (task 19165) are sibling tasks.
Input contract for s5: electronic study forms set up by the research team.
Recruiting, sessions, scoring, analysis and interpretation keep their full time.

s1 keeps 60 because the therapist still reads and decides on every record shown. s5 keeps 20 for checking the forms and fixing values the range checks flag. s7 keeps 75 because the introduction and discussion are written by the therapist.
unknowns: Share of research done by the therapist versus the research team.
research_questions: Do data errors at analysis fall?

incremental.description: Music therapist sets up the study forms with the research team for each study.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: a small study with a short search, so ranking saves little and s1 keeps 85, and half of outcome forms stay on paper, so s5 keeps 60 (13.7); high: a study with a large review and electronic forms (22.7).

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
